create.name: Tess Howell
create.bio:
Tess Howell is a meditation teacher and guide for times of change who grew up in the UK and now lives on the California coast near Santa Cruz. She has practised Insight Meditation for close to thirty years and is accredited by Spirit Rock to lead Dharma and yoga practice. She is also an accredited 5Rhythms teacher, has trained in Buddhist eco-chaplaincy and in SomaSource body-based rites of passage, and is part of the leadership team at the School of Lost Borders, which runs wilderness vigils in the desert.

Her work combines sitting meditation, movement, ritual and honest reflection for people going through endings, new roles or a quiet sense that a chapter is closing. She offers one-to-one mentoring, which can include shaping a simple personal ceremony to mark a passage, and holds seasonal online gatherings drawn from the Celtic calendar. For more than ten years she has led conscious dance outdoors, often with wireless headphones so a group can move together in open country, through the Wild Moves events she founded. On Insight Timer she shares short guided practices and week-long courses on wonder, forgiveness, grounding and finding the sacred in ordinary days.

courses.title: Mentoring for Times of Change
courses.description: One-to-one threshold guidance for people in the middle of a life transition who want to cross it with intention. Sessions can include designing a short personal ceremony to mark what is ending and what is beginning; it starts with a brief introductory conversation.

courses.title: Living Life Sacred
courses.description: A seven-day Insight Timer course of short daily sessions on noticing and deepening a personal sense of the sacred, through attention, the body, beauty, poetry and prayer. No particular faith is assumed.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Making Miracles
courses.description: A week of five-minute Insight Timer sessions for anyone feeling stuck, using poems and light-hearted practices to build trust, leave room for the unknown and notice what is already going well.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Tess Howell on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her guided meditations on acceptance, patience, courage and change, free to play in the app or on the web, alongside several week-long courses.

free_resources.title: Being Moved Conscious Dance community
free_resources.description: A free online group she runs for 5Rhythms and conscious dance, with guided sessions and online dance journeys. No dance experience is needed.
